description: PostgreSQL 18 common-type selection for conditional, array, VALUES, set-operation, domain, and polymorphic expressions
cleanup_sql: DROP DOMAIN IF EXISTS type_matrix_common_positive CASCADE;
sql: CREATE DOMAIN type_matrix_common_positive AS int4 CHECK (VALUE > 0);
SELECT pg_typeof(CASE WHEN false THEN 1 ELSE 2.5 END)::text, (CASE WHEN false THEN 1 ELSE 2.5 END)::text;
SELECT pg_typeof(CASE WHEN true THEN 1::int2 ELSE 2::int8 END)::text, (CASE WHEN true THEN 1::int2 ELSE 2::int8 END)::text;
SELECT pg_typeof(value)::text, value::text FROM (VALUES (1::int2), (2::int8)) AS values_input(value) ORDER BY value;
SELECT pg_typeof(value)::text, value::text FROM (SELECT 1::int2 AS value UNION ALL SELECT 2::int8) AS union_input ORDER BY value;
SELECT pg_typeof(CASE WHEN true THEN 1::type_matrix_common_positive ELSE 2::type_matrix_common_positive END)::text;
SELECT pg_typeof(CASE WHEN true THEN 1::type_matrix_common_positive ELSE 2::int4 END)::text;
SELECT CASE WHEN true THEN 1 ELSE 'x'::text END;
